roadmap.title: Tutorial
roadmap.description: Finish the Tutorial and punch the tutorial character in the room before you leave it.

roadmap.title: Firing Range and loadout
roadmap.description: Use the Firing Range for the horn lever and to price a loadout above $100,000 before buying it in a match.

roadmap.title: Match kills, cash and objectives
roadmap.description: Earn the kill, profit, tower code and truck achievements while you play matches.

roadmap.title: Whole-match goals
roadmap.description: Survive 60 minutes, finish as top earner and win a match without the other teams scoring.

steps.text: Play the Tutorial from the start to the end.

achievements.summary: Punch the tutorial character Christopher with your fists.

guide.context: You can only do this in the Tutorial.

steps.text: Follow the Tutorial and revive @npc{Christopher} when it tells you to.
Keep going until the game tells you to enter another room. Stay in the room you are in.
Walk up to @npc{Christopher}, equip your fists and hit him.

achievements.description: Finish the match as the top cash earner across all teams
achievements.summary: Finish a match as the player who earned the most cash of all three teams.

guide.context: Hot Zone play pays double cash.

steps.text: Spend your time in the @mechanic{Hot Zone} and earn from tower captures, FOB hacks and pallet deliveries.
Stay in the match until it ends and check that you are first for cash earned.

achievements.description: Reach $100,000 net profit in a single life
achievements.summary: Make a $100,000 profit (earnings minus spending) before you die.

guide.context: Net profit is what you earn minus what you spend, so a cheap loadout helps. Dying ends the life.

steps.text: Buy a cheap loadout with good armor.
Earn cash in the @mechanic{Hot Zone} and by delivering supply pallets to a friendly FOB. Delivering pallets in a row adds a bonus.
Stay alive until your profit reaches $100,000.

achievements.summary: Pay $100,000 for one loadout in a single vendor purchase.

guide.context: Spending $100,000 over a whole life, or buying cheaper kits several times, does not count. Prices and level requirements change each season, so check the vendor.

steps.text: Level up and unlock expensive gear, such as the AMR 50 rifle, Level 4 armor and helmet, a backpack with two slings and the 6-10x scope.
In the Firing Range vendor, build a loadout and leave the vendor. Open your inventory with Tab to read its total price. Keep adding gear until the total is above $100,000.
Save up enough cash. In a match, buy the same loadout in one purchase.

achievements.description: Spend 60 minutes in the CZ without dying
achievements.summary: Spend 60 minutes in the Control Zone without dying.

guide.context: Level 4 armor and helmet block the most damage.

steps.text: Join a match and stay in the @mechanic{Control Zone}.
Stay near cover your team has built and avoid pushing fights.
Keep playing until you have spent 60 minutes in the zone without dying.

achievements.description: Get a kill from over 950m away
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy player from more than 950 m away.

guide.context: A Range Finder helps you judge distance. Rain shortens how far you can spot targets.

steps.text: Take a high-power scoped sniper rifle and a Range Finder.
Find a clear line of sight and shoot an enemy who is over 950 m away. Players who stop to bandage are easy targets.

achievements.description: Win a match without another team scoring a point
achievements.summary: Win a match while both other teams have zero points.

guide.context: A match ends at 100 points. Whichever team has more players in the Control Zone scores, and players inside the Hot Zone count double.

steps.text: Move your team into the @mechanic{Control Zone} at the start and hold it.
Keep your team count above both other teams so they never get a point tick, until your team reaches 100.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy player with a ricochet bullet
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy player with a bullet that ricocheted.

steps.text: Shoot at enemies so bullets bounce off hard surfaces first, until a bounced bullet kills a player.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy player using the defibrillator charge
achievements.summary: Use the defibrillator charge to kill an enemy player.

guide.context: The Defibrillator is a Medical item that needs a Battery. It has a Medic level and a cash cost to unlock, which change between seasons.

steps.text: Level up the Medic class until you can unlock the Defibrillator, and pay for it.
Buy the Defibrillator with a Battery.
Charge it and shock an enemy player until they die.

achievements.description: Steal an enemy Ural loaded with supply pallets, drive it to your FOB and unload all the pallets
achievements.summary: Steal an enemy Ural loaded with supply pallets, drive it to your FOB and unload every pallet.

guide.context: The Ural is the truck that carries supply pallets. Hard impacts destroy pallets, so drive carefully.

steps.text: Find an enemy @item{Ural} that is carrying supply pallets.
Take the driver seat and drive it to your own FOB.
At your FOB, interact with each pallet and choose UNLOAD SUPPLIES until all are unloaded.

achievements.description: Guess at least 3 numbers correctly on the Drill Tower
achievements.summary: Enter the Drill Tower code keypad with at least 3 numbers guessed correctly.

guide.context: Each tower you capture shows one digit of the match code. A match has about 3 to 5 towers and the code changes every match. A wrong entry can lock the keypad for a short time. If a map has three or fewer towers, the console shows symbols instead of digits until your team owns every tower.

steps.text: Capture a tower in the @mechanic{Control Zone}: clear it, go to the operations floor and hold interact at the console until the capture finishes.
Note the digit it shows. Capture more towers to learn more digits.
At the keypad beside the console, enter the code and guess the digits you still do not know.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with the backblast of an RPG or CGM4 while in the Control Zone
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with the backblast of an RPG or CGM4 launcher while in the Control Zone.

guide.context: This needs a Defibrillator and a launcher. The backblast is the fire that comes out of the back of the launcher.

steps.text: In the @mechanic{Control Zone}, kill a player and remove all their gear.
Drag the body into a corner.
Use the defibrillator to revive the player.
Turn quickly so the back of your launcher faces them, and fire.

achievements.description: Pull the horn lever in the firing range
achievements.summary: Pull the horn lever in the firing range.

steps.text: Go to the firing range, look around it for the horn lever and pull it.
